repo_notes.author: Lampac maintainers
repo_notes.content:
Public DeepWiki for lampac-nextgen/lampac. This is not Devin Enterprise: no playbooks, secrets files, or ACU effort levels. wiki.json pages are an explicit 30-page cap (public DeepWiki maximum). Generate exactly these pages.

ROLES: Canonical operator docs are Russian Mintlify at https://docs.lampac.dev (source: docs/ with docs.json). GitHub Pages site/ is an Astro marketing hub (pages.yml builds site/dist) that links and redirects old HTML to Mintlify. DeepWiki is the English code-grounded twin: explain where topics live in the repo and link the matching docs.lampac.dev URLs. Do not paste install scripts, docker-compose dumps, or API tables — those belong on Mintlify.

SOURCE OF TRUTH: application code, config/base.conf, config/example.init.conf / example.init.yaml, module manifest.json files. Not DeepWiki, not site/, not generated wiki text.

FACTS: default port 9118; listen.ip is "any" in base.conf; RCH WebSocket is /nws (not /ws); torrent Online source is PidTor (not PiTor); JacRed APIs are /api/v1.0 and /api/v2.0; health check GET /version?type=hash. SkipModules in base.conf: Catalog, Tracks, Transcoding, WebLog, CacheMedia, ForkPlayerXML, MsxNative, Potok, TelegramAuth, TelegramAuthBot. Starter example.init.conf additionally skips DLNA, JacRed, Sync, TimeCode, TorrServer. manifest enable false includes AdminPanel, DatabaseEditor, Music, WatchTogether, TelegramAuth/Bot, Tracks, Transcoding, Telemetry. Rezka premium is Rezka.premium in config, not a provider named RezkaPremium.

LAYOUT: Core/ host (Program.cs, Startup.cs, Middlewares/, Controllers/, plugins/, wwwroot/); Shared/ library (CoreInit, AppConf, BaseController, HTTP pools, HybridCache, PlaywrightCore, CSharpEval); Online/ VOD core; SISI/ 18+ core; Modules/ feature and provider projects; NextGen.slnx. After publish, Core.csproj copies module sources to module/ and TestModules to mods/ beside Core.dll. Compose files docker-compose.yaml and docker-compose.dev.yaml live at repo root (there is no docker/ directory). Mintlify root is docs/. Pages landing is site/. Helm chart is charts/lampac/. CI is .github/workflows/. Custom overlays: mods/.

IGNORE as architecture: temp/, gitignored lampac-docker/, bin/obj, vendored binaries, every SVG under wwwroot. Do not treat site/ Astro pages as API docs. Never emit real tokens, passwd contents, provider cookies, or private hosts.

When a Mintlify nav group is added in docs/docs.json, fold it into an existing wiki page or replace a leaf. Do not add a 31st page.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: English introduction to Lampac NextGen: ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) self-hosted Lampa backend on port 9118. How Core, Shared, Online, SISI, and Modules/ cooperate. Point readers to https://docs.lampac.dev for operator docs and to child wiki pages for code maps. Do not duplicate the Russian landing page.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Map clone-and-run paths in the repo: docker-compose.yaml, docker-compose.dev.yaml, install.sh, build.sh, config/example.init.conf, config/example.init.yaml. Default port 9118 and GET /version?type=hash. Link Mintlify; do not paste full install scripts.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.purpose: How CoreInit in Shared loads init.conf / init.yaml, merges config/base.conf, and hot-reloads. Cover AppConf models under Shared/Models/AppConf (listen, online, sisi, cache, puppeteer, pool). Provider section keys live beside Modules/Online* ModuleConf. Distinguish base defaults vs starter example.init.conf.

pages.title: Security and Access
pages.purpose: WAF, Accsdb, GeoIP, Cloudflare IP lists, kit encryption, and passwd usage. Source: Core/Middlewares/WAF.cs, Accsdb.cs; Shared security/geo helpers. Document public-exposure risks without publishing secrets. Accsdb and Kit must not be merged into generic API docs.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Layer diagram in code terms: Core host, Shared services, Online and SISI cores, Roslyn module compile, middleware pipeline. Repository map of Core/, Shared/, Online/, SISI/, Modules/. Link child pages. Operator overview stays on Mintlify.

pages.title: Core Host and Middleware
pages.purpose: Core/Program.cs and Startup.cs: DI, module load, Map("/nws"). Middleware order in Core/Middlewares: RequestInfo, WAF, Accsdb, Module/ModuleAsync, Staticache, ProxyAPI (HLS/DASH/MPD), ProxyImg, OverrideResponse. Core/Controllers for version, geo, RCH. Media proxy models in Shared.

pages.title: Shared Library
pages.purpose: Shared as the common library: BaseController, CoreInit, module interfaces (IModuleLoaded / IModuleConfigure), HTTP client factory, HybridCache and Staticache, Pools, CSharpEval/Roslyn, GeoIP, PlaywrightCore. How Online and SISI consume these services.

pages.title: Module Loader
pages.purpose: How Core discovers and compiles modules from module/ and mods/, ApplicationPartManager, FileSystemWatcher hot reload, manifest.json enable, BaseModule.LoadModules / SkipModules. Runtime vs repo copy rules in Core/Core.csproj.

pages.title: Modules Overview
pages.purpose: Catalog of in-tree Modules/ families and how to read state: manifest enable, SkipModules in base.conf vs example.init.conf. Honest defaults: Music/WatchTogether/AdminPanel manifest-off; TorrServer/JacRed/Sync skipped in starter; Catalog/Tracks/WebLog skipped in base.conf. Link child group pages instead of one page per module.

pages.title: Client and Content Modules
pages.purpose: Code map for Online/ (/online.js, /lite/*), SISI/ (/sisi.js), Modules/NextHUB, Modules/LampaWeb, Modules/Music (manifest off), Modules/LampacApk, Modules/WatchTogether (manifest off). Point to each module README and Mintlify module page; do not copy plugin JS.

page_notes.content: User-facing guides: https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/online https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/sisi https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/nexthub https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/lampa-web https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/music https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/lampac-apk https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/watch-together

pages.title: Media Modules
pages.purpose: Code map for Modules/GStreamer, TorrServer, JacRed, PidTor, DLNA, Catalog, Tracks, Transcoding. Note starter SkipModules for TorrServer/JacRed/DLNA and base.conf SkipModules for Catalog/Tracks/Transcoding. JacRed routes /api/v1.0 and /api/v2.0. PidTor spelling.

page_notes.content: User-facing guides: https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/gstreamer https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/torrserver https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/jacred https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/pidtor https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/local-media https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/dlna https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/catalog https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/tracks https://docs.lampac.dev/modules/transcoding

pages.title: Sync Modules
pages.purpose: Modules/Sync subtree: sync.js, storage, bookmarks, TimeCode. SQLite paths. Starter example.init.conf skips Sync and TimeCode. Map controllers and database files without dumping API tables.

pages.title: Proxy Modules
pages.purpose: Modules/Proxy/TmdbProxy and CubProxy, plus CorsMedia, CorsEU, CacheMedia, ProxyLimiter. Cache directories under cache/. CacheMedia is in base.conf SkipModules. Contrast with Core ProxyAPI middleware (stream proxy vs module proxies).

pages.title: Admin Modules
pages.purpose: AdminPanel (manifest off), DatabaseEditor (manifest off), WebLog (base SkipModules, needs passwd), Telemetry (manifest off), LogUserRequest. Hub page modules/admin-tools on Mintlify. Do not document live admin credentials.

pages.title: Integration Modules
pages.purpose: Modules/Community/TelegramAuth and TelegramAuthBot (base SkipModules, often manifest off), SeriesNotify, Kit (encrypted credentials for paid providers), ExternalBind (often disabled), ForkPlayerXML, MsxNative, Potok (base SkipModules). Kit storage paths and consumption by OnlinePaid.

pages.title: Providers Overview
pages.purpose: How VOD providers are grouped: Modules/OnlineRUS, OnlinePaid, OnlineAnime, OnlineENG, OnlineUKR, OnlineGEO, Adult/. Enabling groups via SkipModules/LoadModules. Do not invent a RezkaPremium provider. PidTor is the torrent Online source.

pages.title: Russian and Paid VOD
pages.purpose: Representative projects under Modules/OnlineRUS and Modules/OnlinePaid (Rezka including Rezka.premium config, Filmix, KinoPub, Kodik, HDVB, Collaps, and peers). Per-provider ModuleConf vs Online/Config. No one wiki page per provider.

pages.title: Anime ENG UKR GEO
pages.purpose: Modules/OnlineAnime (13 sources including AniLibria, AnimeLib, AnimeON), OnlineENG, OnlineUKR (Ashdi, Kinoukr, not AshdiTV), OnlineGEO (AsiaGe, Geosaitebi). Folder layout and shared Online controller patterns.

pages.title: Adult Content
pages.purpose: SISI/ shared pipeline vs Modules/Adult/<Site>/ one project per platform, plus NextHUB YAML under Modules/NextHUB/sites/. Bookmarks/history SQLite in SISI core. WAF limits. Do not scrape or duplicate adult catalogs.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Repo artifacts for Docker (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yaml, docker-compose.dev.yaml, GHCR), Linux install.sh and systemd, Windows release zip + dotnet Core.dll, Helm charts/lampac/, reverse-proxy notes. Link Mintlify deployment pages; do not paste compose files.

pages.title: Maintenance
pages.purpose: Release/update flow (install.sh --update, GitHub releases, rsync excludes), troubleshooting entry points (logs/, journalctl, /version?type=hash), and pointer to custom modules child page. Mintlify holds operator procedures.

pages.title: API Overview
pages.purpose: Where routes are declared: [Route] attributes on Core/Controllers and module controllers. Plugin JS: /online.js, /sisi.js, /gst.js. WebSocket /nws. Hand-written API MDX on Mintlify is canonical; this page maps code to those docs. No OpenAPI unless the repo adds it.

pages.title: API Core and Auth
pages.purpose: Core/Controllers (version, geo, diagnostics, RCH ingestion) and authentication/accsdb gates. NativeWebSocket /nws in Core/Startup.cs. Link Mintlify API core and authentication pages instead of reproducing request/response tables.

pages.title: API Online SISI Music
pages.purpose: OnlineApi, /lite/*, SISI API and SQLite bookmarks, Music /music.js and /music/* (manifest off). Source: Online/, SISI/, Modules/Music. API contracts stay on Mintlify.

pages.title: API Media and Sync
pages.purpose: GStreamer /gst/*, Sync /storage/ and /bookmark/, TorrServer /ts/*, JacRed /api/v1.0 and /api/v2.0. Source modules under Modules/. Map controllers to Mintlify API pages; do not duplicate parameter lists.

page_notes.content: User-facing guides: https://docs.lampac.dev/api/gstreamer https://docs.lampac.dev/api/sync https://docs.lampac.dev/api/torrserver https://docs.lampac.dev/api/jacred https://docs.lampac.dev/api/modules

pages.title: API Proxies Admin Telegram
pages.purpose: Proxy module HTTP surfaces, AdminPanel /adminpanel/ (manifest off), Telegram auth/bot/notify endpoints. Source: Modules/Proxy, AdminPanel, Community, SeriesNotify. Never document live tokens.

pages.title: Docs Sites Mintlify Pages DeepWiki
pages.purpose: Three surfaces: docs/ Mintlify (docs.json, MDX, content path /docs), site/ Astro GitHub Pages hub (pages.yml builds site/dist; / and /en/; old .html stubs redirect to Mintlify), .devin/wiki.json public DeepWiki (30-page cap). Agents: docs/AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/mintlify-docs.mdc, .agents/skills/mintlify*. DeepWiki is not a source of truth and must not copy MDX.

pages.title: Repository CI and Publish
pages.purpose: NextGen.slnx, build.sh, Core/Core.csproj publish layout (module/, mods/, runtimes/references/). Workflows: build.yml, test-build.yml, release.yml, format-code.yml, pages.yml, reusable-docker-build.yml. GHCR image, Helm charts/lampac/, site/ Pages artifact. Do not treat CI YAML as runtime config.

page_notes.content: CI lives in .github/workflows/. Pages builds Astro in site/ and publishes site/dist. Docker image: ghcr.io/lampac-nextgen/lampac. Helm: charts/lampac/.

pages.title: Playwright and Provider Patterns
pages.purpose: Shared/PlaywrightCore (Chromium/Firefox pools), how Online and SISI controllers request rendered pages. Typical provider project: manifest.json, ModInit.cs, Controller, ModuleConf. NextHUB YAML + Roslyn scripts. Do not document bypass recipes as exploits; describe the code layout only.

pages.title: Custom Modules and TestModules
pages.purpose: User overlays in mods/, TestModules/ copied to mods/ on publish, IModuleLoaded/IModuleConfigure, hot reload. How to enable a stock module that is SkipModules or manifest-off by overlaying a copy. Mintlify custom-modules page is the operator procedure.
